=ELG=
Out of the blue this is where ELG starts. So here we have the full reference grammar of La Bangu. Not for newbies obviously. So it's strange that we call it a continuation of the ''Crash Course''.

''Extended Lojbanic Grammar'' is the reference grammar of [[La Bangu]], a Lojban dialect developed by [[Fancy Generation Lojbanists|Lojbanic community]] in IRC chat channel #lojban. Compared to [[CLL]] ELG is more bulky.

ELG is to be written mostly in simple Lojban. Many borrowings from English are expected. Many parts of ELG are based on CLL.

<font color="#00F">(developers edition, paragraphs to be excluded from popular version are marked in small font)</font>

These are Berry Lessons that present different interesting aspects of Lojban language, it's grammar, vocabulary and applications in different fields.
*~ - in progress
*+ - more or less stable
